summary: Meta-analysis interprets evidence; a scheduled sweep supplies the repeatable cadence and evidence shape.

items.text: When the meta-analysis runs on a cadence, give it a named schedule, a gate-compatible evidence shape and a shared trust-layer queue.
Publish calibrated findings and follow-up tasks into Trust Layer; the report interprets evidence, while the layer owns the broader review and evidence surface.
See Context Compaction & JIT Retrieval for the related use case or counterpoint: Less context, retrieved on demand, beats more context dumped upfront.
See Fire, Track, Review for the related use case or counterpoint: Review the artifact, not the agent. Dispatch the task, track the output, inspect the result.
